query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS requests_count FROM thesis_requests tr
JOIN users u ON u.id = tr.examiner_id
WHERE u.role = 'examiner' 
AND (u.loginMethod IS NULL OR u.loginMethod = 'NULL')
AND u.openId REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{2}';
